_comment: NX-035 repo2: the IAM policy of the DATA_HOST backup sub-user (pgBackRest repo2 and the journal restic repo2). Prefix-scoped like the NEX-EIOS backup identity, with its measured TOS spellings (tos:ListObjects on the bucket TRN with the condition key tos:prefix in lower case; GetObject/PutObject on the exact prefix TRNs). Unlike it, tos:DeleteObject is granted: pgBackRest expire and restic forget/prune remove their own old objects. Multipart actions are for large uploads. No bucket configuration action. The APP_HOST sub-user: the same shape with nexloop/restic-files/ only. Check the multipart action names against the TOS IAM action list before applying.
